created: 2026-11-19, after the runs; derived from the original records, not captured by the runs
why: the original reports showed 'Task type classified as expected 100%', which counted the fallback as a correct classification and hid the failed classifier calls, and showed 0 cost for unpriced usage

classification_attempts.evidence: every gold item was sent with task_hint=auto (the evaluator at 14e0cf1 sets it)

classifier_failures.evidence: the per-case ledger shows failed_calls=1 on exactly these requests, and the recovered/captured run-wide ledger shows the failed rows are classify calls with that code; inferred, not recorded per request

valid_model_classifications.evidence: attempts minus the failed classifier calls

fallback_requests.evidence: a failed classification means qa by design (app/ai/answer/execute.py at 14e0cf1); these requests still published

final_route_accuracy.evidence: task_ok in the original records (the FINAL route, fallback included)

model_classification_accuracy.value: unavailable: the route the model itself returned was not recorded by this run

cost.value: unknown/unconfigured: the ledger's 0 meant 'not priced' (no price settings); the original reports' 0.00000 must not be read as free
